title: i400 AC Current Clamp - Current Accuracy Tests

source.document: Fluke i400 AC Current Clamp - Calibration Information (part 2414311)
source.tables: Table 3 (p. 6), Figures 2 and 3 (pp. 6 - 7), Table 2 (p. 5), Electrical Specifications (p. 3)
source.note: Fluke i400 Calibration Information 2414311, Table 3 Accuracy Tests (p. 6)

equipment.calibrator: AC current 0 - 8 A, 0.15 %, 45 - 400 Hz (recommended: Fluke 5520A; the program also offers the 5560A and 5522A)
equipment.multimeter: AC current 1 mA - 400 mA, 0.5 %, 45 - 400 Hz (recommended: Fluke 189 in mA ac)
equipment.wire_loop: single-turn copper wire loop, larger than #14 gauge, 6 in diameter

general: The multimeter is pre-calibrated at each step with the calibrator (LCOMP OFF) and its error is added to the clamp reading (Table 3 footnote, p. 6): the program does this when the pre-calibration option is on.

measure.note: AC current function of the reading multimeter; the manual states no filter or speed (UNVERIFIED engineering choice: 20 Hz AC filter on the 34410A / 34411A).

sections.title: Current accuracy - single-turn wire
sections.setup: Calibrator output (5560A: VI AUX / OUTPUT LO; 5522A / 5520A: AUX HI / AUX LO) through a single-turn copper wire loop (larger than #14 gauge, about 6 in diameter) - the clamp jaws closed round the wire, centred (Figure 2, p. 6).  The clamp output cable goes to the multimeter mA ac input and COM.  Calibrator LCOMP OFF.

sections.title: Current accuracy - 50-turn coil
sections.setup: Calibrator current output (below 3 A: 5560A VI AUX / OUTPUT LO, 5522A / 5520A AUX HI / AUX LO; 3 A and above: 5560A 30A / OUTPUT LO, 5522A / 5520A 20 A / AUX LO) through the 50-turn coil (Fluke 5500A/Coil) - the clamp jaws closed round the coil, centred (Figure 3, p. 7).  The clamp output cable goes to the multimeter mA ac input and COM.  Calibrator LCOMP ON.
